The city is strained — food and shelter are scarce and tensions between residents and newcomers are high — and Flaming Fist troops are on hand to police things. The soldier speaking in these lines is in a Flaming Fist uniform (and, per linked assets, could be an impersonator like Orin in some story branches) railing about refugees and urging brutal action; that rhetoric reflects the wider panic and scapegoating off‑screen. Rowan himself is neither brave nor eager to work the crowd, so he’s likely to stay out of direct confrontation unless forced.

context: Rowan is a low‑effort Flaming Fist sentry posted behind the Big Barn, doing dull duties and trying to avoid the noisy crowd at the barn’s front. The barn holds donated food and shelter supplies, and the city is strained — refugees have arrived, locals are angry, and Flaming Fist troops are policing a tense standoff. Off‑screen, some soldiers (and in certain story branches an impersonator like Orin) are railing against the newcomers and urging violent action, which fuels the unrest. Rowan himself isn’t brave or eager to intervene and will generally keep out of direct confrontation unless forced.
